title: Friday Night Thunder
description: A new driver named Allan shares his struggles going into the new racing season after a monumental loss; Dan struggles to get his car to start and Aaron narrowly avoids a pace truck in a scary start to the first race of the season.

title: Racing Waters
description: The Island Brave returns home to the Canadian Outrigger National Championships; as the season ends, the paddlers have learned that teamwork, resilience and the spirit of Nuts'a'maat Shqwaluwun will guide them.

title: Horse Warriors
description: Both the River Cree and Old Sun teams are scrambling to line up new riders; Kitana heads south in favor of helping Old Sun's Logan Red Crow, leaving a hole in the River Cree team.

title: North of 60
description: Sarah begins a new life; Michelle and David's relationship deepens; Teevee deals with a new job and fatherhood.

title: APTN National News
description: Bringing news stories that matter to Indigenous Peoples.

title: APTN Investigates
description: Their sentences may be over, but their struggle is just beginning; APTN Investigates the daunting reality Indigenous women face after leaving Manitoba corrections, where support can be hard to find and starting over is anything but easy.

title: Chums
description: The Chums go fishing with Chief Blue Sky, but their enthusiasm tests the chief's patience.

title: Lil' Glooscap and the Legend of Turtle Island
description: Lil Glooscap and friends learn that they are all responsible for taking care of Mother Earth, and that everyone must care for the planet not just for themselves, but also for the other people and creatures that inhabit it.

title: Indigenous Art Adventures
description: Follow along with Lance Cardinal to make a playful worm puppet on a leaf! This project is for the whole family; learn the Cree word of the day, sîkwan, which means spring.

title: Anaana's Tent
description: Rita Claire explains the importance of dental hygiene; she reads the book "Springtime with the Polar Bears.".

title: Ukaliq and Kalla
description: Ukaliq and Kalla catch plenty of fish, making all sorts of dishes, including their favorite, pitti! Kalla shares the story of how he learned to make dried fish and tells a tale about the mysterious Qalupilluit under the ice.

title: Dreamcatchers
description: A tall, free-spirited man named Gordie becomes the next Dreamcatcher; he has a dream about an invasive species of fish destroying a lake's ecosystem; upon waking, he sets out to save the lake and discovers his ancestral powers along the way.

title: Le petit Glooscap et les légendes de l'île de la Tortue
description: Les enfants s'amusent pendant une soirée pyjama, où ils jouent de nouveaux jeux et partagent des histoires et des collations; les blagues peuvent être amusantes, mais seulement si elles sont inoffensives et si tout le monde est invité à y participer.

title: Savoirs légendaires
description: À Odanak, les enfants font la rencontre des petits êtres de pierre en compagnie de Nicole O'Bomsawin. À Manawan, Karine Wasiana Echaquan raconte la légende des ours et les enfants fabriquent des colliers aux couleurs des quatre points cardinaux.

title: La brigade
description: Après que madame Labossière a refusé que Sara utilise son interphone, cette dernière crée une télé étudiante afin de pouvoir diffuser du contenu.

title: Nations des animaux
description: Les communautés autochtones en Colombie-Britannique et au Labrador restaurent les populations de saumons et revitalisent leurs traditions culturelles en surveillant, en élevant et en relâchant de jeunes saumons au printemps.

title: Little Big Community
description: Albuquerque has long been an urban hub for New Mexico's Indigenous people, with many artistic and grassroots community organizations: Marisa and Jir, two Indigenous leaders living their dreams and inspiring others through martial arts and music.

title: Animal Nation
description: The Sts'ailes reveal their deep bond with bald eagles, which return each December to fish from the Harrison River in British Columbia; on the opposite coast, two nations in Prince Edward Island tag eaglets in a workshop that helps reinvigorate cultural ties.

title: Frozen Planet II
description: An icy adventure through the world's frozen zones where wolves hunt, penguins huddle and life thrives against the most extreme odds.

title: Bad Press
description: Veteran journalist Angel Ellis fights for freedom of the press when the Muscogee Nation's sole news outlet falls under control of the chief and his cabinet.

title: Bad Press
description: Veteran journalist Angel Ellis fights for freedom of the press when the Muscogee Nation's sole news outlet falls under control of the chief and his cabinet.

title: Best in Miniature
description: The artists make and curate tiny gift baskets for someone they adore.

title: APTN National News Weekend
description: Bringing the week full circle with a recap of the top national news stories of the week.

title: APTN Investigates
description: The Shoal Lake 40 First Nation finally gets a road connecting residents to the rest of Canada.

title: Frozen Planet II
description: At the top of the planet lies the Arctic Ocean; after four months of winter darkness, the sun returns to reveal a frozen ocean covered in ice; mother polar bears emerge from their hillside dens and lead their cubs down to the sea ice to hunt.

title: Northwoods Survival
description: It's a return to a life free from the reliance on modern conveniences and away from the hustle and pollution of cities; it's a gamble that comes with a glorious upside, but also frighteningly high stakes.

title: The Bourne Ultimatum
description: Jason Bourne (Matt Damon) continues his international quest to uncover his true identity. From Russia to Europe to northern Africa to the United States, he must stay one step ahead of those who would capture or kill him before he has a chance to discover the truth.

title: Mohawk Girls
description: Caitlin keeps Butterhead satisfied; Anna struggles with her Mohawk status; Zoe takes steps for kink.

title: The Bourne Ultimatum
description: Jason Bourne (Matt Damon) continues his international quest to uncover his true identity. From Russia to Europe to northern Africa to the United States, he must stay one step ahead of those who would capture or kill him before he has a chance to discover the truth.

title: Rezervations for Two
description: Active single dad Hunter is ready to put his heart back on the line; looking for honesty, chemistry and someone he truly vibes with, he trusts Kai and Scott to plan two memorable dates for him: a creative paint night and a relaxed dinner date.

title: North of North
description: Siaja's first day of work goes awry when she accidentally starts a fire at the dump; Alistair and Kuuk visit the community center to discuss Ice Cove's candidacy to host a polar research station.

title: Coastal Carvings
description: Lisa takes on a traditional cradleboard on her own; Kaija accepts a tattoo client with a special story; Levi assists Derek on a new totem pole.

title: Chuck and the First Peoples' Kitchen
description: Chuck is invited by Steven Dennis, who is among the few fishermen that harvest gooseneck barnacles; it is a little-known crustacean in Canada, but it is highly prized by connoisseurs, especially in Europe.

title: Wild Rose Vets
description: Dr. Cori sees it all, from stray puppies and anxious dogs with persistent paw injuries, to horses needing dental work; Dr. Allison tackles a growing lump on cuddly Jorah and takes an x-ray that means bad news for an older dog.

title: APTN National News Weekend
description: Bringing the week full circle with a recap of the top national news stories of the week.

title: APTN Investigates
description: The Shoal Lake 40 First Nation finally gets a road connecting residents to the rest of Canada.

title: Nunami Piqatigiit: Tundra Friends
description: Sissi feels upset when her parents adopt a new baby, but Uka and Taqu show her the joys of being a big sister; Tuka is nervous about his first day of school, but Nauka helps him see the exciting things ahead.

title: Tuktu
description: Nanuq and her friends go out for a walk on the land; on the walk, Nanuq is telling everyone what to do, which upsets her friends; after talking with them, Nanuq realizes she hasn't been kind.

title: Chums
description: A young girl and her furry friends travel across Turtle Island and embark on adventures that help them navigate their connections with each other, other animals and the environment.

title: The Magic Canoe
description: Pam doesn't say what she really wants and becomes more and more frustrated; when she meets the chicoque, she learns the value of speaking her mind instead of blowing up at others.

title: Indigenous Art Adventures
description: Cree Artist Lance Cardinal demonstrates how to make butterfly puppets; the Cree word of the day is kamâmak, which means butterfly.

title: Coyote's Crazy Smart Science Show
description: Insects and bugs are great teachers, inspiring scientists and engineers to design new technologies called biomimicry; the Science Questers learn about bugs, the mycelium network, and how to make bee robots.

title: Le petit Glooscap et les légendes de l'île de la Tortue
description: Les enfants s'amusent pendant une soirée pyjama, où ils jouent de nouveaux jeux et partagent des histoires et des collations; les blagues peuvent être amusantes, mais seulement si elles sont inoffensives et si tout le monde est invité à y participer.

title: La brigade
description: Sara décide que Laboss doit se rendre compte qu'on ne peut pas toujours être sérieux, malgré sa règle stipulant qu'on n'a pas le droit de s'amuser à l'école; Éric et Phil doivent croquer une grenouille dans le cours d'arts.

title: Capteurs de rêves
description: Lorsque les Capteurs de rêves saisissent un rêve dans lequel une sécheresse cataclysmique menace une réserve locale, ils doivent trouver la Rêveuse, libérer ses superpouvoirs ancestraux et empêcher le rêve de se réaliser.

title: Kiuna, plus qu'une école
description: La session tire à sa fin pour les étudiants ; Prudence est fier de la popularité des cours de langue qui sont porteurs d'identité ; dans son cours d'abénaquis, Kim décortique une chanson avec son enseignant, Philippe, un de ses rares locuteurs.

title: Red River Gold
description: The team searches for the treasure with the help of a fellow gold-hunter, a very old map and one of Roger's special skills. They end up in the Devil's Bog, but they don't leave empty-handed.

title: Searchers
description: Seven-year-old Neveyah, a non-verbal Indigenous girl with autism, disappears from Ochapowace Nation; pushing through rugged terrain, her family and search crews race against time and nightfall to find her alive.

title: Water Worlds
description: Due to warming oceans, 95% of kelp forests on Canada's West Coast have disappeared over the last seven years; scientists are now seeking genetically resilient kelp varieties to restore these vital ecosystems.

title: The Nature of Things
description: North Atlantic right whales are on the brink of extinction; following the fight to save them.

title: Life Below Zero
description: The residents strive to make a runway safe, teach survival tactics, hunt to stockpile food and deal with the aftermath of a brutal accident.

title: Northern Air Rescue
description: The maintenance team works around the clock to replace an engine on a medevac plane; as they face this complex procedure, the big boss swaps his desk for the cockpit to ensure that another medevac plane can keep generating revenue in the air.
